patterns.key_values: notch-mounted status pill: brand glyph left, percentage + circular progress ring right; full-notch-width rounded-black bar, ~28-32pt tall; always-visible glanceable status
dark HUD dropping from the notch; collapsed bar persists as header; body = 2-up stat cards + list card + 2-dot carousel; radius ~24pt outer / ~13pt cards; tonal elevation not borders
2 equal stat cards, 3-tier stack each (lowercase label / bold currency value / dimmed token submetric); shared top-bottom axes; ~12px gutter
header with lowercase title + trailing capsule toggle (active<->all-time); rows = name (ellipsis-truncated) + right-aligned bold dollar + middot + dimmed token count; right-aligned value axis

signature_moves: Usage-as-spend hierarchy: the whole product idea (tokens cost money) is carried by de-emphasis alone — bold dollar primary, raw token count demoted to dimmed tertiary submetric, in both cards and every list row
Two-color semantic split: clay/terracotta pixel-invader = brand identity, never functional; mint-green ring/toggle = budget-remaining status, always paired with the % glyph
All-lowercase micro-labels as a calm typographic house style (not tracked-uppercase web tell, not Title case) so bold numerals stay the only loud element
Notch is the entire surface: Dynamic-Island mental model ported to the Mac notch, a 2-page carousel replacing a settings screen; no window/traffic-lights/toolbar (correctly chromeless)
defects: Contrast Dilution (mild, non-text) — stat-card fill #18 on panel #0E ~1.3:1, below 3:1; internal card boundaries nearly invisible, lean on wallpaper edge to read as grouped
Contrast Dilution (borderline, text) — dimmed tertiary token counts / middot on darkest card likely <4.5:1; acceptable as decorative secondary data but noted

aesthetic.direction: neo-grotesque product (near-black + one mint accent, tonal-elevation cards) spiked with a terminal/hacker pixel-art mascot

psychology: Von Restorff / hierarchy-by-de-emphasis — the bold dollar is the one remembered thing because the token count is deliberately pushed back to gray
Jakob's Law — adopts the iOS Dynamic Island schema (glyph + collapse/expand + status ring) so the Mac-notch behavior is already learned
Goal-gradient / Zeigarnik — the depleting green % ring reads as a budget/progress meter, nagging when low
Doherty / glanceability — zero-click always-visible 57% in the notch answers 'how much left?' with no interaction
Miller-Cowan chunking — content held to ~3-5 chunks per level (2 stat cards, 2-3 list rows, 2 pages)
notes: Inputs are a menu-bar/notch utility, not a windowed app: no traffic-light chrome, sidebar, toolbar, or settings surface was captured, so lineage=native rests on genre + SF Pro + material grammar rather than observed AppKit chrome (confidence med). The 'icon' file is 100x64 (not a square app icon) — it is the pixel-invader glyph render, terracotta rgb(200,120,90), the Claude brand color. Cover is a 155-frame screen-recording GIF downscaled to 700x375, so ALL pixel measurements are (estimated) with wide ranges and type is expressed in kit-role-relative terms, not false pt precision. Dark-mode-humility: cannot confirm Liquid Glass vs solid dark material from the still, recorded as opaque-dark. Green ring/toggle is an app-chosen functional color, not the system accent — legitimate for glanceable status. Contradiction to watch: brand color (clay) is not the accent color (green) — a deliberate split, not an inconsistency. This is the corpus's first notch-companion / menu-bar-utility surface; a synthesis pass should open (not populate) that cluster and must not promote its dark-HUD tokens to macOS canon on a single native-but-genre-inferred app.
